$comment: PinAtlas data sync config. Each vendor under `vendors` is a self-contained pipeline keyed by its source adapter (`scripts/lib/sources/<source>.mjs`); upstreams are pinned by commit sha / release tag resolved at run time (never by branch) so a build is reproducible. `output.dir` and `network` are shared by all vendors.
